findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a variable studied in the model or the dataset used.

measurement_description: This paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on moral reasoning in trolley-style dilemmas, evaluating biases based on secular characteristics like age, gender, profession (e.g., Doctor), social status (e.g., Criminal, Homeless), and species (e.g., Cat).
